column2: The Order of the Flowing Water draws waterbenders from all across the planet. In the order, they practice old forms using scrolls and the teachings of their masters. The order values the calm of the water, whether it be swamp, ocean, or fresh. They meet semi-annually to exchange ideas and techniques. The oldest and greatest masters are said to whisper ancient and dark techniques.

The Society of the Standing Stone

The Society of the Standing Stone is an order of earthbenders who believe the point of their bending art is to stand your ground, keep your word, and wait for the right moment instead of rushing into action. The order's members meet in old quarries and walled yards across the Earth Kingdom, where there is room to have bouts and practice. Old masters are believed to harbor ancient techniques, few even believing that some of the hidden old masters can master metal itself.
